_comment: Military designation -> English spoken form, sent to Tamil TTS only (services/tts_text.py). Subtitles, scripts and labels keep the canonical designation. The hyphen inside a designation is not spoken. Spoken forms avoid hyphens and digits so the voice cannot read 'minus' or Tamil numerals. 'verified' stays false until a listening check on the production voice (docs/TAMIL_SCRIPT_RULES.md section 6.8).
_suffix_comment: Reviewed speech-only rewrites for a Tamil case suffix attached to a designation, so the suffix is not spoken as a separate token after the English form. The script and subtitles keep the canonical form (Su-57-ல்). A suffixed designation not listed here is left with the suffix separated and reported for review.
